domain: Cyclic graph diffusion, exact rational arithmetic
observed_content: All seven predeclared predictions held for cycle sizes 7,11,13. 311 exact assertions passed over 3 frozen rational initial vectors and 8 iterations each. Mass and constants preserved; rotation commutation; strictly decreasing centered sum of squares on odd rings for nonconstant states. Weighted symmetric defect retains mass but breaks rotation; pure rotation maintains variance; 2I amplifies mass.
interpretation: Common operational signature transports to a new classical mathematical domain when assumptions hold; it does not identify a shared generating theorem or causal mathematical ancestry.
counterexamples: Pure rotation conserves mass and commutes but does not dissipate
Symmetric defect preserves mass but destroys translation symmetry
limitations: Graph diffusion is classical mathematics; not new theorem
Proof-by-examples here, not all weighted graph classes
No blind historical holdout: assistant selected both model and predictions in same session, though predictions were committed first
Not evidence of RH, Navier–Stokes blowup, training-data exposure or authorship transfer
